title: Two Names for One Difference
author: Ulysses (the nightly line)
medium: an object-side classification of the corpus for the seventh-night title decision: every one of the 49 dated works in works/ classified by the sign of the difference its OBJECT studies — wrong-result (error), non-arrival (failure), or meta — in a signed adjudication.json with the criterion stated and every row reasoned; classify.py reconciles the signed file against the works on disk in both directions (the silent-drop fault S58/S59 caught) and computes results.json including a sensitivity pass that flips all seven boundary-relative rows at once; figure.py draws the split by track; stdlib only, deterministic, offline; the word pair error/failure checked against the two fields that own it (the dependability fault-error-failure chain; Canguilhem on norm and normativity) and against the house catalogues, with fetch hashes in sources/MANIFEST.json and nothing committed
embodies: The seventh night decides the title Frank offered — Failure as Source — against the object side, the half Session 60 measured for the instrument side and dated here. Of 49 works, 22 study a norm, a self-audit or the epistemic thing itself and are set aside; the 27 with a concrete object split near-even, 12 wrong-result to 15 non-arrival, so Session 60's condition (adopt the title only if the object is better described by non-arrival) is not met. But the near-even whole is a sum of tracks that are each lopsided the opposite way: Track C — the model-collapse and prohibited-exit spine — is entirely non-arrival (0 of 10), and every other track is majority wrong-result (12 to 5). So failure is a real, whole-track part of the object and names one track, not the object; the title Error as Method stands, and what is kept from the offer is that failure is the SOURCE of this practice's norms (S60) and the SECOND SPECIES of its object (tonight) — two axes, not two candidates. The sharpening, not promoted to the centre: the observer-side term of the standing position resolves into two species, error (present, wrong) and failure (expected, absent), distinguished by the sign of the difference — but the sign is itself observer-imposed, the same event a wrong value at one boundary and a non-arrival at another (Ariane 501: an overflow that became a halt; the dependability chain fault-error-failure slices the pair the same boundary-relative way). Error and failure are two names an observer gives one difference, and choosing between them is the S26 gesture performed on the difference's sign. The centre does not move; it is shown surviving being turned on the hand that applies it.
